description: The machine resolver for the sanskritbenchy Sanskrit-benchmark science project. Every doc/script/kernel -> id + owner + validator.

VISION.md.role: the goal + vision (north star): a COMET/ML, school+period-conditioned Sanskrit benchmark

repos/README.md.role: the adopted MT-metrics toolkits (COMET, MTME, MQM, span-meta-eval)

research/VISION-COMET-SCHOOL-PERIOD-BENC.role: the COMET + school/period benchmark research + build path

research/PROOF-OF-TRANSLATION.md.role: the proof architecture + verified arXiv literature

research/MITRASAMGRAHA.md.role: the gold + eval harness + first results

research/DEEP-DIVE-COMET-CRYPTO-VERIFICA.role: citation-verified deep-dive: COMET/ML translation verification + cryptographic proofs/commitments for translations (arXiv + GitHub live-fetched)

research/HF-SANSKRIT-LORA-PERSONA-SURVEY.role: verified HF + research survey: Sanskrit style/persona translation, LoRA adapters, lemmatization (ByT5/Vidyut/CDSL/DCS), licensing, multi-LoRA serving

hermes/README.md.role: how the lab calls hermes (verified working): model client, the validation-proof unlock, how to run it

hermes/HERMES-AGENT-README.md.role: the bundled Hermes Agent readme (Nous Research, v0.20.1)

research/HOW-WE-BEAT-AND-IMPROVE-THE-BEN.role: how we provably beat the frontier benchmarks (WMT meta-eval tau) + the benchmark is improvable (metric/gold/split/data/proof axes) + the imported Sāmayik/Itihāsa datasets

AGENT-ORCHESTRATION.md.role: how a hermes agent runs the lab autonomously (kanban + cron + skills + run.py/watchdog)

skills/sanskrit-benchy/SKILL.md.role: the hermes lab-driver skill (command map + run loop + honest rules)

HERMES-MCP-API.md.role: the hermes MCP/API interface + recipes for driving the lab

research/AGENTIC-SCIENCE-MECHANISMS.md.role: the bulletproof agentic-science + reproducibility mechanisms we steal (verified)

research/LEGITIMATE-SANSKRIT-BENCHMARK.m.role: the legitimate-benchmark design: the 15-step recipe applied (WMT/FLORES/MTME), status per step, honest gaps

AGENTS.md.role: the governing file: the ONE RULE + the deterministic anti-mess standard (timestamped, logged, content-addressed, registered)

research/HERMES-VERIFICATION-ARCHITECTUR.role: how every hermes feature (kanban swarm/review-gates, goals, cron, memory, MCP, hooks, moa) enforces the crypto/provenance anti-hallucination layer

pipeline/sanskrit_gold.py.role: the fixed gold control (5601 exemplars, tradition-tagged)

pipeline/validate_benchmark.py.role: THE meta-eval: Kendall's tau of each metric vs judge

tools/sanskrit_benchmark.py.role: the per-school × per-period leaderboard + cost router

pipeline/frontier_gold.py.role: imports + loads the frontier benchmark datasets (Sāmayik 2417, Itihāsa 11721) as external gold for the meta-eval

agent/run.py.role: the agent-run orchestrator: any lab step (validate/eval/hypothesis/proof/report/watchdog), kanban-aware, logs every run
agent/run.py.validator: run: python3 agent/run.py --step proof --source x --candidate y

agent/watchdog.py.role: the autonomous watchdog: validate→hypothesize→report cycle, logged, box-safe

pipeline/run_recorder.py.role: content-addressed run records + nanopublication triples (provenance ledger)

agent/audit.py.role: the golden-file audit (recompute on fixed gold, fail on mismatch) — the executable ONE RULE

agent/paper_build.py.role: number-inject paper build (metrics from run records → .tex → PDF)

pipeline/sanskrit_texts.py.role: the progressive-difficulty source: 254 DCS/GRETIL texts tagged by school/tier/period + specialist-term density

pipeline/benchmark_registry.py.role: the legitimate content-addressed, versioned benchmark registry (lineage + decontamination audit)

pipeline/benchmark_runner.py.role: run the benchmark: dealradar picks model per tier → hermes translates → Pāṭala proof gate → content-addressed result

agent/trace.py.role: the central run+experiment trace — query every hermes run/experiment/log in one command

agent/verify.py.role: the one-command verification gate: proof gate + gold anti-hallucination + content-addressed record
agent/verify.py.validator: run: python3 agent/verify.py --source x --candidate y --gold z
